About this room

Spacious family deluxe room featuring 1 Queen bed and 1 Single bed, private toilet, and full multimedia entertainment.

Our Family Deluxe Room provides ample space for up to 3 guests (or families with children). Configured with 1 Queen-size bed and 1 Single bed, individual air conditioning, private attached bathroom, and a TV with multimedia TV box box for YouTube, Spotify, and streaming apps.

En-suite private bathroom comes equipped with a hot shower, toilet, body & hair shampoo, floor mat, fresh towels, slippers, and hairdryer.
